events.speaker: WINNIE
events.text: Torn, is it. Let me see what's worth saving before you tell me what it cost you. Sit over there and don't hover. I can't think with a man breathing down the seam.

events.speaker: WINNIE
events.text: Better than it started out. I'd not say that where whoever cut it first could hear me, but it's so, and that shoulder won't go on you again.

events.speaker: WINNIE
events.text: I read a county by what it can afford to wear, and this one is wearing last year's. A place suits me. I'll want good light and nobody borrowing my shears for a chore.

events.speaker: WINNIE
events.text: Any man in this county I can measure by eye at forty paces. I've had you wrong twice now, and I find I've started enjoying being wrong.
